description: Figure 7 is a bar chart that illustrates the number of questions out of 40 where Chain of Thought (CoT) generated by GPT-3 using different methods has at least one factual error. The x-axis represents different methods, including NoR, OneR, and IRCoT, while the y-axis shows the number of questions with factual errors. The bars are color-coded: red for NoR, blue for OneR, and yellow for IRCoT. The chart shows that IRCoT has the fewest factual errors, followed by OneR, with NoR having the most. The values range from 5 to 29, with IRCoT consistently showing the lowest number of errors across all methods.
